text: dsh-mobile-upgrade 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的移动界面增强插件，通过客户端扩展和服务端设置、重启路由，为手机窄屏提供更顺手的会话操作。它加入可收起的侧边栏浮动入口、可滚动的问题卡片、连接状态卡片与请求提示，也让会话列表在后台流式更新时减少重复渲染。用户还可从顶部收纳面板浏览会话谱系、子代理和后台任务，并用独立开关启用或关闭各项功能。适合经常从手机访问 DSH Web、管理多个会话或遇到连接与列表卡顿的用户；无需额外 API 密钥，安装后可在插件设置中调整功能。

dsh-mobile-upgrade improves DSH Web on phones with a floating sidebar, scrollable question cards, connection notices and a compact header for lineage, subagents and jobs. It reduces repeated session-list rendering during background streaming. Feature switches are in plugin settings.
想在手机上更方便地浏览 DSH 会话和侧边栏。
DSH Web 的问题卡片太长时，能不能让选项仍留在屏幕里？
后台会话一直有更新，导致列表很卡，有什么办法改善？
让手机上的 DSH 页面能从一个按钮展开完整会话抽屉。
连接断开或请求卡住时，我想看到状态并手动重连。
在小屏幕上查看会话谱系、子代理和后台任务太挤了。
How can I make the DSH web session list stay responsive during background streaming?
I need a phone-friendly way to open the full DSH sidebar and switch sessions.
dsh-mobile-upgrade 的功能「手机侧边栏」：在窄屏用浮动按钮打开完整侧栏抽屉，并支持从按钮所在一侧滑入。点击按钮触发，供用户浏览和切换会话。
dsh-mobile-upgrade 的功能「问题卡片滚动」：窄屏时将较长的问题内容限制在独立滚动区域，使选项和提交控件仍可使用。用户在待回答的问题卡片内滚动查看内容。
dsh-mobile-upgrade 的功能「连接状态卡片」：在页面左下角显示连接状态，并汇总卡住或失败的 API 请求。点击卡片可手动重连或刷新页面，也能发起服务存活探测。
dsh-mobile-upgrade 的功能「会话列表节流」：将高频投影变化合并为较低频的列表重绘，减少后台会话持续流式更新时的重复渲染。功能在客户端加载时启用，数据仍保存在各会话状态中。

dsh-mobile-upgrade README · dsh-mobile-upgrade：Mobile quality-of-life fixes for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) web profile, shipped as a single plugin. Almost everything renders through the host's own slots and state signals — no layout takeover, no DOM polling of chat content. A few overlays are fixed-position plain DOM on purpose — the bottom-left connection chip/card, the self-update banner, the shared toast: they must stay alive exactly while the host's own React tree is frozen.

dsh-mobile-upgrade README · What you get：- **Restart row** — a "Restart service" entry in Settings → General. Confirms first, restarts the `dsh` process, and reloads the page automatically once the service answers again.
- **Narrow-screen drawer** — below 1024px the collapsed sidebar parks fully off-screen, replaced by the plugin's own floating button: a plain-DOM 56px round translucent element that is not the sidebar (the old chip was the sidebar itself, resized — broken by host rebuilds and skin restyles), with its own icon — the host's whale cloned and stripped of styling hooks — at a size pinned against any skin. Tapping it asks the host's own drawer controls (`[data-sidebar-opener]` / `[data-sidebar-toggle]`) to expand and slides the full-height sidebar in from the button's side as soon as the host lays the expanded rail out; the button fades out while the drawer stands, and a close tap (scrim, session row, header toggle) slides it back out in the same frame. The panel's width never changes, the transform-only slide cannot freeze halfway; the open drawer still paints an opaque surface from the theme's own sidebar tokens that a glass skin cannot turn transparent. dsh-mobile-upgrade README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mobile-upgrade
```

Restart `dsh web`, then open the web profile on your phone: the restart row sits in Settings → General and the feature toggles in Settings → Plugins → dsh-mobile-upgrade. Attachments come from the host's own composer attachment system.

dsh-mobile-upgrade README · Install：Requires `dsh` 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer; developed and verified against `dsh` 0.2.2 (the host's built-in attachment system replaced this plugin's upload feature). 0.2.2 already ships a narrow-screen drawer, settings tabs, a bounded model menu and a per-model input-type editor; this plugin no longer duplicates them, so those overrides were removed rather than re-hashed, and what remains is the floating-button takeover plus the enhancements below.

dsh-mobile-upgrade README · Configuration：The plugin's settings card lists one switch per feature (see [Feature toggles](#feature-toggles)); `restartEnabled` also gates the restart route:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `restartEnabled` | `true` | Offer the restart row and its route |

dsh-mobile-upgrade README · Feature toggles：Every feature above can be switched in Settings → Plugins → dsh-mobile-upgrade (effective on the next page load), or overridden per device with a `localStorage` key — `mfx-restart`, `mfx-drawer`, `mfx-net`, `mfx-questions`, `mfx-selfupdate`, `mfx-agents`, `mfx-header`, `mfx-listthrottle`, `mfx-conn` — where the value `"0"` turns a feature off.

dsh-mobile-upgrade README · Limitations：- The client binds host UI elements through published `data-*` contracts (`data-sidebar-drawer`, `data-sidebar-collapsed`, `data-sidebar-mask`, `data-sidebar-toggle`, `data-sidebar-opener`, `data-rightbar-col`, `data-shortcut-modal`, `data-slot`) and, where the host publishes no attribute, through the local part of a CSS-module class name (`_sidebarCol`, `_crumbs`, `_tabs`). Both survive a rebuild: the hash in front of a local name is the only thing a rebuild changes. A host build that renames those contracts degrades the affected feature until this plugin catches up; everything else keeps working. The question card's question region rides the card's own `data-question-key` hook.
- The header collector and the lineage click shim ride the host's own data (the live session list and its subagent catalogs); they add no requests beyond the guarded branch fetches, and a tap on a row whose mode is still loading completes on its own once that catalog lands.
- Input-modality switches can only patch provider routes you have customised yourself; catalog-only routes are read-only by design, because fabricating a catalog section collapses the model direct

dsh-mobile-upgrade README · Security notes：The plugin's HTTP routes (restart, settings editing) run on the same web server as the host's own, so they are fenced through the connection service's `requestRejection`: the same Host/authority check and browser-session check the host's gateway applies (403 for an untrusted authority, 401 without a valid browser session). A route that restarts the process or rewrites the profile's provider directory is therefore not reachable from the network unauthenticated. On a host that does not expose that face, the routes fall back to the deployment's own gate and the host half logs a warning — put the deployment behind whatever gate protects the rest of the UI (reverse-proxy auth, loopback binding) before exposing it beyond localhost.
